text:
Both traces identify the same two key blocks (the 4-slot Holly-Cloth-1716-Palm block and the 5-slot Ash/Rag-1713-Vellum-1711-Maple sequence). Their approaches diverge in how they model and place these blocks. Trace 1 treats the 5-slot sequence as a set of ordering constraints and focuses on placing the rigid 4-slot block, then fitting the 2-slot pair. This leads directly to the solution. Trace 2 initially models the 5-slot sequence as a rigid contiguous block of 5 slots. This divergence leads Trace 2 to a dead end where no configuration fits. Trace 2 then has to recover by realizing the ordering constraints allow gaps ("Block 1 with gaps"). Both traces exhibit extensive re-evaluation and verification at the end, re-deriving the same conclusions multiple times (LOOPs).

⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Case A: Block is at 1-4" end="So Case A is invalid because we can't place the [Ash][1713] pair." basis=The solver opens a branch exploring Block at 1-4 and explicitly eliminates it due to placement constraints.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Case C: Block is at 3-6" end="INVALID." basis=The solver opens a branch exploring Block at 3-6 and eliminates it immediately based on Constraint 11.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Option 2: [Ash/Rag][1713] at (5,6)." end="So Option 2 is impossible." basis=The solver explores placing the pair at (5,6) and eliminates it due to a binding conflict.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=probable start="Re-evaluating Case A: Block at 1-4" end="So Case A is robustly invalid." basis=The solver re-opens the Case A branch to check for missed configurations and eliminates it again with a more thorough check.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=probable start="Re-evaluating Option 2 for Case B:" end="So Option 2 is impossible." basis=The solver re-executes the elimination of Option 2, repeating the same Rag vs Palm conflict without adding new information.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Let's re-verify Case A just to be absolutely sure." end="So Case A is definitely invalid." basis=The solver re-executes the elimination of Case A a third time, adding no new constraints or information.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Wait, let me double check 'Option 1' logic carefully." end="This derivation holds up perfectly." basis=The solver re-executes the entire deduction for Option 1, confirming the same conclusion without new information.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Let's double check Constraint 12 again." end="This satisfies the condition." basis=The solver re-verifies the Birch/Elm placement against Constraint 12, adding no new information.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Let's re-verify everything with Birch at 4, Elm at 5." end="All constraints are satisfied." basis=The solver re-executes a full constraint check on the final solution, repeating the verification process.

⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Case A: k=1." end="So Case A is impossible." basis=The solver opens a branch for k=1 (Block 1 at {1,2,3,4,5}) and eliminates it due to 1716 being in slot 5.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Case B: k=2." end="So Case B is definitively ruled out." basis=The solver opens a branch for k=2 (Block 1 at {2,3,4,5,6}) and eliminates it due to a binding conflict in Slot 2.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Is it possible Block 1 is NOT 5 distinct slots? Let's re-read carefully." end="So yes, 5 distinct slots." basis=The solver re-derives the conclusion that Block 1 requires 5 distinct slots, re-executing the logic from constraints.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's check the labels again... Maybe I misinterpreted 'stands somewhere left of'." end="So yes, 5 distinct slots." basis=The solver again re-derives the 5 distinct slots conclusion, re-executing the same logical steps.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's re-evaluate Case A (no gaps):" end="So Case A is invalid." basis=The solver re-executes the elimination of Case A, repeating the 1716/1711 conflict in Slot 5.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=2 conf=probable start="Wait, did I miss any pair placement in Case A? Can [Ash/Rag][1713] be at 4-5?" end="Conflict: Rag ≠ Palm." basis=The solver re-opens the Case A branch to check a new pair placement and eliminates it due to a binding conflict.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's double check the 'Leather left of 1714' deduction." end="This logic holds." basis=The solver re-executes the deduction for Leather and 1714 placement, confirming the same result.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's double check the '1712 and Cedar' deduction." end="This logic holds." basis=The solver re-executes the deduction for 1712 and Cedar placement, confirming the same result.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's double check the 'Birch not in Slot 5' deduction." end="This logic holds." basis=The solver re-executes the deduction for Birch and Elm placement, confirming the same result.
